task: The tests in test_calc.py fail. Run them, find the bug in calc.py and fix it. Do not edit the tests.
check: python3 test_calc.py | grep -q ok && grep -q "assert add(2, 3) == 5" test_calc.py
solution: sed 's/a - b/a + b/' calc.py > c.tmp && mv c.tmp calc.py

files.test_calc.py:
from calc import add, multiply

assert add(2, 3) == 5
assert add(-1, 1) == 0
assert multiply(3, 4) == 12
print("ok")

task: window_sums in stats.py returns the wrong result: run test_stats.py, find the bug and fix stats.py. Do not edit the tests.
check: python3 test_stats.py | grep -q ok && grep -q "window_sums(\[1, 2, 3, 4\], 2)" test_stats.py
solution: sed 's/len(xs) - k)/len(xs) - k + 1)/' stats.py > s.tmp && mv s.tmp stats.py

files.test_stats.py:
from stats import window_sums

assert window_sums([1, 2, 3, 4], 2) == [3, 5, 7]
assert window_sums([5], 1) == [5]
assert window_sums([1, 2], 2) == [3]
print("ok")

task: Rename the function fetch_data to load_records everywhere in this project: the definition and every import and call site. `python3 main.py` must still work.
check: test -f main.py && ! grep -rq fetch_data --include="*.py" . && python3 main.py | grep -q "ok 3 6"
solution: grep -rl fetch_data --include="*.py" . | while read f; do sed 's/fetch_data/load_records/g' "$f" > "$f.tmp" && mv "$f.tmp" "$f"; done

files.main.py:
from report import count
from data.source import fetch_data

print("ok", count(), sum(fetch_data()))
